nilecrz
Brand book

A design system for a luxury Nile cruise marketplace that explains before it sells. Open any card for its live, interactive preview; every page has a Day / Night switch. Guidelines for each component are in its folder’s README.md.

Colour · semantic

  • surface#fbf9f4 / #0b1424Page background — warm ivory by day, the river at night in dark.
  • surface-raised#ffffff / #111d33Cards, the search panel, popovers, booking summary.
  • surface-sunk#f4efe5 / #070e1aAlternating page bands, inputs inside raised panels, footer.
  • tint#ece3d3 / #1c2a44Quiet fills: selected calendar day ground, hovered rows, skeletons. Never under body text smaller than 15px in light.
  • line#ddd3c2 / #26365aDecorative hairlines and dividers (not control borders — use line-strong).
  • line-strong#7c8597 / #65769aControl borders: inputs, outline buttons at rest, steppers. ≥3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk in both themes.
  • ink#1a2b4b / #f2ede3Headings and body text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk and tint (≥11:1 in both themes).
  • ink-muted#5a6478 / #a9b3c5Secondary text, metadata, captions on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk and tint (≥4.6:1 both themes).
  • accent#7a5822 / #d9bf8cBrass as text: eyebrows, prices, small ornaments, active nav underline. Readable on every surface and tint (≥5:1).
  • accent-soft#f1e6d1 / #2a2416Ground for accent text in badges and highlighted rows.
  • primary#1a2b4b / #d9bf8cPrimary action fill (Check availability, Request to book) and selected states. Navy by day, brass by night.
  • on-primary#ffffff / #0b1424Text and icons on a primary fill — never hard-code white.
  • success#2f6046 / #8cc7a2Confirmed, available, free cancellation. Always paired with a word or check icon; on surface, raised, success-soft.
  • success-soft#e3eee6 / #143024Ground behind success text.
  • danger#a3392a / #f0a08eSold out, errors, last-cabin warnings. Always paired with a word or icon; on surface, raised, danger-soft.
  • danger-soft#f6e2dc / #3a1a15Ground behind danger text.
  • focus#34507f / #d9bf8cKeyboard focus ring: solid 2px, offset 2px. ≥6:1 on every surface in both themes.
  • scrimrgba(11, 20, 36, 0.55) / rgba(7, 14, 26, 0.62)Overlay on photography so on-media text holds 4.5:1; Hero and image captions.
  • on-media#ffffff / #f2ede3Text and icons placed on photography over scrim (nav over hero, hero headline).

Colour · palette

  • nile-950#0b1424Palette · midnight river. Scene night sky, dark surface. Same in every theme.
  • nile-800#1a2b4bPalette · the brand navy (light ink and primary). Same in every theme.
  • nile-600#34507fPalette · river blue; scene water, focus ring in light. Same in every theme.
  • nile-300#9fb2d1Palette · morning haze; scene dawn sky. Same in every theme.
  • brass-700#7a5822Palette · deep brass; accent text in light. Same in every theme.
  • brass-500#b08a4ePalette · polished brass; ornaments, cover, scene sun. Decorative only — 2.9:1 on ivory, never small text.
  • brass-300#d9bf8cPalette · pale gold; accent and primary in dark, sails in scenes.
  • sand-200#ece3d3Palette · desert sand; tint in light, scene banks.
  • sand-100#f5f0e6Palette · papyrus; scene light, soft grounds.
  • ivory#fbf9f4Palette · ivory; light surface.
  • dusk-500#c0714aPalette · sunset copper; scene dusk sky and sun. Decorative only, never text.
  • dusk-300#e7b38aPalette · afterglow; scene dusk horizon.

Components

Pages

LandingPage

A full homepage composed from the system, showing hero and search, three ways to sail, side-by-side comparison, price explainer, cruises, itinerary and gallery.

Open live preview →

Education

AmenityGrid

Icon tiles for a vessel's facilities, each marked Included, On request or Not aboard, with filter chips and a note revealed on hover or focus.

Open live preview →
PriceAnatomy

The "why US$800 vs US$8,000" explainer: two five-star presets and six factors that build the price live in a stacked bar, each with what you notice on board.

Open live preview →
VesselCompare

Interactive comparison of the three vessel types: tabs with an illustration, five meters (intimacy, quiet, free itinerary, facilities, heritage) and a fact list, or all three side by side.

Open live preview →
VesselTypeCard

Explains one of the three ways to sail: illustration, nickname, name, one honest sentence, three facts and a link.

Open live preview →

Discovery

CruiseCard

A listing card for one sailing: scene or photo, vessel type, name, route, nights, guests, rating, amenity icons, price per person, save and compare.

Open live preview →
ExperienceCard

Portrait image, uppercase serif title, two-line description and an outline "See details" button, for on-board and ashore experiences.

Open live preview →
Gallery

"Captured moments" carousel: snap-scrolling frames that tilt in 3D as they pass centre, with a counter, progress line and arrows.

Open live preview →
ItineraryTimeline

Day-by-day route drawn as a river: click a stop or press play and the boat sails there, with the day number, title, story and site tags below.

Open live preview →

Booking

BookingSummary

Booking panel with a guests stepper, line items, gratuity and flight toggles, a counting total and Request to book (no payment).

Open live preview →
CabinPicker

Radio cards for cabin categories with a mini floor plan, size, deck, bed, price and scarcity or sold-out state.

Open live preview →
CruiseSearch

Floating search bar with route, vessel type, a departure calendar showing real sailing days, and guests. It reports how many departures match.

Open live preview →

Layout

Hero

Full-bleed opening with a scene or photo, scrim, eyebrow, display headline, lead and an optional floating slot (usually CruiseSearch).

Open live preview →

Navigation

NavBar

Brochure-style navigation: language switch, centred wordmark, call-to-action and a link row with a sliding brass underline.

Open live preview →

Content

SectionHeading

Centered eyebrow, uppercase serif title, brass ornament and intro: the opening of every section.

Media

Scene

Placeholder river art in four lights (dawn, day, dusk, night) with a chosen vessel, temple pylon, palms and water glints.

Open live preview →
VesselArt

Side-profile illustration of a vessel type: motor cruise ship, sailing dahabiya, paddle steamer or felucca.

Actions

Button

The action button: `primary` for the one main action, `outline` for secondary, `ghost` for tertiary and `link` for inline navigation.
